description: Reference libraries for Project Arrhythmia modding
releaseNotes:
# 25.5.2 [Alpha]
Bug fixes and usability improvements.
## Changes
- Update color selectors in the editor.
- Shape selector now better handles when it should expand or collapse extra settings.
- Editor tutorial objects / events / markers are now more robust.
- General minor improvements to readability and usability of the editor.
- Minor general menu improvements.
- Added the crash playerpref to the demo intro (until the new intro is implemented and tested for release later this week)
- Testing new build settings to improve consistency across platforms (may help with song creation).
- **Improved player core rendering such that it's position is no longer tied to FPS.**
## Features
- You can now disable the tutorial objects on level creation.
- Seizure warning added back into the game.
## Player Changes
- Slightly reverted base game speed back to 22 units (default is 20, 25.5.1 was 25).
- Reverted start acceleration.
- Increased the stop acceleration speed of the player back nearly to the original value (4) it's now 5 up from 2 in 25.5.1. This is faster then it was previous and should it should feel more snappy on keyboard.
- Removed the instant turn acceleration cancel.
# [Alpha] -> [Default]
Expect this build to be on default soon assuming no major issues found.
